scope: Additive verification of existing frozen target/decomposition records; no scientific trials or status changes
binding: The caller supplies a preregistered SHA256 for source results. Every certificate binds item, curve_id, target_id (implicit zero only for the sole Fp2 target per curve), exact target point, and the source hit flag. Strict natural targets additionally bind the original ordered workload.
coverage: Reject missing, duplicate, extra and wrong-target certificates; reject empty certificate input whenever source results contain hits
constraints: Replay on-curve points and sums in Jacobian coordinates; prime interval bound; all four strict abscissae distinct; Fp2 projected-base membership; exact point counts, prime subgroup order and generator checks where supplied
independence: Group addition/doubling uses Jacobian formulas, independently from the scientific affine solver. Finite-field arithmetic remains shared with diagnostic.cpp; this is internal cross-track review, not external formal certification.
json: Vendored nlohmann/json v3.12.0; duplicate object keys rejected
adversarial_controls: four repeated points with false strictness claim on a consistent copied planted target
preservation: Original verifier, raw outputs, protocols and reports are never overwritten. Root will amend the original report after this additive verification succeeds.
